# DirectX Shader Compiler (prebuilt)

`bin/x64/dxc.exe`, `dxcompiler.dll`, `dxil.dll`, `dxv.exe`, `inc/` and `lib/` are Microsoft's
[DirectX Shader Compiler](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler) release binaries and headers, as the
upstream XenosRecomp repository ships them. They are under the DirectX Shader Compiler's own licence (University of
Illinois/NCSA Open Source License, with parts under the MIT and Apache-2.0 licences, and the DXIL redistribution terms
for `dxil.dll`): see `LICENSE.TXT` and `ThirdPartyNotices.txt` in the DirectX Shader Compiler repository and its release
packages.
